about: The crypt's Bone market (docs/milestones/connected-biomes.md, CB11): The shop: a floating slab with three spots of its shelf in a row across its middle; a wizard who steps onto an item with its price in their wallet buys it. Its edge a broken lip (crypt_edge) and an invisible wall (its void a wall), sockets on its east and north and south and west sides for the bridges. tools/ground_shape.py draws crypt_shop_ground.tscn and its art from this.
